technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with multiple overbought conditions and breakout signals, but intermediate trend weakness (below 50-MA) and low relative volume create execution risk on a swing entry.

fundamental.summary: TT shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 57 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional purchases are modest and dated (95+ days old), providing weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (346.7) with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; 57-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (dc20 new high, AO cross-up, Ichimoku TK cross-up) with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) creates contrarian buy opportunity near support at 131.63.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 346.7, negative macro score -3), price is below both 50-MA and 200-EMA, multiple overbought oscillators signal exhaustion, and 57-day earnings window presents uncompensated event risk with zero fundamental support.
